title: Enhancement: Add support for NH-4010 platform in sonic-mgmt
author: dt-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

NH-4010 needs to be added in a few areas to successfully run sonic-mgmt tests on the Nexthop 4010 TH5 platform.

### Current Behavior

There is no support for this platform

### Proposed Behavior

Add support
